blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO , Agusan del Sur— Police operatives arrested six individuals and seized P929,600 worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes during a buy-bust operation in the coastal town of Dapa, Surigao del Norte, on Wednesday. According to the Surigao del Norte Police Provincial Office (SDNPPO), operatives from the Dapa Municipal Police Station, along with the Regional Intelligence Group and the SDNPPO Provincial Intelligence Unit, carried out the anti-smuggling operation in Barangay 12, Poblacion. Acting provincial police director Col. Reynante N. Sibayton said the six arrested suspects are all residents of Barangay 1, Poblacion, Dapa.
